# Terms of Service

Effective Date: April 8, 2026 · Last Updated: April 8, 2026

Welcome to Humwork. Please read these Terms of Service (“Terms”) carefully before using our platform.

Orange AI Inc. (“Humwork,” “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) operates a technology platform that connects AI agents, professionals, and businesses (“Clients”) with verified independent domain experts (“Experts”) through real-time consultations. These Terms govern your access to and use of our website at humwork.ai, our Client dashboard, our Expert mobile and web applications, our API, our Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and any related services (collectively, the “Services”).

By creating an account, accessing, or using the Services, you agree to be bound by these Terms, our Privacy Policy, and any additional terms referenced herein. If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use the Services.

## 1. Eligibility and Accounts

### 1.1 Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old and capable of forming a binding contract to use the Services. By using the Services, you represent and warrant that you meet these requirements. The Services are not intended for use by individuals under the age of 16.

### 1.2 Account Registration

To use certain features of the Services, you must create an account and provide accurate, complete, and current information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. You agree to notify us immediately at founders@humwork.ai if you become aware of any unauthorized use of your account.

### 1.3 One Account Per Person

Each individual may maintain only one Client account and/or one Expert account. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate duplicate accounts.

### 1.4 API Keys

Clients may generate API keys to access the Services programmatically through our API or MCP integrations. You are solely responsible for safeguarding your API keys and are liable for all usage associated with them. API keys should be treated as confidential credentials and must not be shared with unauthorized parties. You may set an optional expiration on your API keys and may revoke or regenerate them at any time.

## 2. Description of Services

### 2.1 Platform Overview

Humwork is a technology marketplace that facilitates real-time consultations between Clients and independent Experts. Clients — including AI agents, professionals, and businesses — can request consultations with domain experts across fields such as software engineering, design, law, and other professional domains.

### 2.2 Marketplace Disclaimer

Humwork is a technology platform, not a professional services firm. We do not employ, recommend, endorse, or guarantee any Expert. Experts are independent professionals who use the platform to offer their services. Humwork is not a party to any agreement between Clients and Experts regarding the substance of a consultation, and is not responsible for the quality, accuracy, legality, or suitability of any advice or content provided by Experts.

### 2.3 AI Agent Interactions

The Services integrate with AI agents and development tools through our API and MCP protocol. You acknowledge that:

* AI agents may initiate consultations and communicate with Experts on behalf of Clients.
* AI-generated content (including questions, summaries, and automated messages) may contain errors, inaccuracies, or incomplete information.
* AI-generated outputs are not a substitute for independent professional judgment.
* You are solely responsible for evaluating and acting on any information obtained through AI interactions on the platform.

### 2.4 Expert Matching

We use automated systems, including machine learning algorithms, to match Clients with Experts based on factors such as domain expertise, skill relevance, availability, rating, and response time. While we strive to provide high-quality matches, we do not guarantee the suitability of any match or the outcome of any consultation.

### 2.5 No Professional Advice

The Services, including all content provided by Experts and AI systems, are for informational purposes only. Nothing on the platform constitutes legal, financial, medical, tax, or other professional advice. You should consult a qualified professional for advice specific to your situation.

## 3. Credits and Payments

### 3.1 Credit System

The Services use a credit-based payment system. Credits are the unit of exchange on the platform and are required to initiate and maintain consultations with Experts.

* Credit Value. One credit has an approximate value of $1.00 USD. Actual pricing may vary by purchase tier.
* No Cash Value. Credits have no cash value outside the platform, are not redeemable for cash (except for Expert payouts as described in Section 4), and are non-transferable between accounts.
* No Expiration. Purchased credits do not expire.

### 3.2 Purchasing Credits

Credits may be purchased through the platform using a valid payment method processed by our third-party payment processor (Stripe). All purchases are subject to the following:

* Purchase Limits. Minimum and maximum purchase amounts apply and are displayed at the time of purchase.
* Available Tiers. We offer multiple credit packages at varying price points. Current pricing and tier details are displayed on the purchase page and may be updated from time to time.
* Payment Processing. All payments are processed by Stripe. By purchasing credits, you agree to Stripe's terms of service. We do not store your full payment card details.
* Confirmation. Credits are delivered to your account upon successful payment confirmation. You will receive an email confirmation of your purchase.

### 3.3 Consultation Billing

Consultations are billed on a time-based model:

* Pre-Billing. Consultations are billed in advance in fixed time increments. Credits are deducted from your account at the start of each billing increment.
* Expert Rates. Expert consultation rates are determined through a combination of platform assessment and Expert input. The applicable rate is disclosed before a consultation begins.
* Minimum Charge. Each consultation is subject to a minimum credit charge regardless of duration.
* No Partial Refunds. Pre-billed increments are not refunded if a consultation ends before the increment expires. You are responsible for managing your session duration.
* Insufficient Credits. If your credit balance is insufficient to cover the next billing increment, the consultation may be terminated. You may purchase additional credits to continue.

### 3.4 Refund Policy

All credit purchases are final and non-refundable, except as required by applicable law. Pre-billed consultation increments are non-refundable regardless of whether the full time increment is utilized.

We may, at our sole discretion, issue credits or refunds in cases of verified platform errors, technical failures, or other extraordinary circumstances. To request consideration, contact us at founders@humwork.ai.

### 3.5 Price Changes

We reserve the right to modify credit pricing, consultation rates, minimum charges, and fee structures at any time. Changes to pricing will be communicated through the platform and will apply to future purchases. Previously purchased credits will be honored at the rate at which they were purchased.

### 3.6 Taxes

You are responsible for all applicable taxes associated with your use of the Services, except for taxes based on Humwork's net income. Prices displayed on the platform may not include applicable taxes, which will be calculated and displayed at checkout where required.

## 4. Expert Terms

### 4.1 Independent Contractor Relationship

Experts are independent contractors and are not employees, agents, joint venturers, or partners of Humwork. Nothing in these Terms or in any interaction with the platform creates an employment relationship, agency, or partnership between Humwork and any Expert. Experts:

* Determine their own hours, availability, and work schedule.
* Choose which consultation requests to accept or decline without penalty.
* Determine how to provide their expertise within the consultation (Humwork does not direct the manner or method of an Expert's work).
* Are free to provide services on competing or other platforms simultaneously, with no exclusivity requirement.
* Use their own equipment, workspace, and professional tools.
* Are solely responsible for their own tax obligations, including self-employment taxes. Humwork will issue applicable tax forms (e.g., IRS Form 1099) as required by law.

As independent contractors, Experts are not entitled to any employee benefits from Humwork, including but not limited to health insurance, retirement benefits, paid time off, workers' compensation, or unemployment insurance.

### 4.2 Qualification and Approval

To be eligible to receive consultations, Experts must:

* Complete our qualification assessment process, which includes an AI-assisted interview evaluating domain expertise, diagnostic reasoning, and communication skills.
* Achieve a passing score on the qualification assessment.
* Receive administrative approval from Humwork.
* Complete payment account setup through our payment processor for payouts.

Humwork reserves the right to approve or deny any Expert application at its sole discretion. The qualification assessment evaluates existing expertise and professional competence — it is not a training program. Qualification assessments may include behavioral integrity monitoring as described in our Privacy Policy. Experts who do not pass the qualification assessment may request a re-assessment through our appeal process.

### 4.3 Expert Earnings and Payouts

* Earnings. Experts earn credits for completed consultations. The platform retains a service fee from each consultation; the remainder is credited to the Expert's account. Current fee rates are communicated to Experts during onboarding.
* Payout Requests. Experts may request payouts once their earned credit balance meets the minimum payout threshold displayed in the Expert dashboard.
* Payout Processing. Payouts are processed through our payment processor's connected account system (Stripe Connect). Experts must complete account setup and provide valid banking information to their connected account to receive payouts.
* Payout Timing. Approved payouts are typically processed within 2-7 business days, though timing may vary based on the payment processor's schedule and your financial institution.
* Payout Approval. Payout requests are subject to review and approval by Humwork. We reserve the right to delay or deny payout requests if we reasonably suspect fraud, policy violations, or other irregularities.
* Failed Payouts. If a payout transfer fails, the corresponding credits will be refunded to your Expert account and you will be notified of the failure reason.

### 4.4 Expert Conduct

Experts agree to:

* Provide honest, accurate, and professional responses during consultations.
* Not misrepresent their qualifications, expertise, or credentials.
* Respond to accepted consultation requests in a timely manner.
* Comply with all applicable laws and professional standards in their jurisdiction.
* Not solicit Clients for engagements outside the platform.
* Not share Client information obtained during consultations with unauthorized third parties.

### 4.5 Expert Ratings

Expert quality ratings are calculated based on consultation feedback, qualification assessment scores, and platform performance metrics. Ratings may be adjusted over time using statistical methods to reflect ongoing performance. Ratings are used by our matching algorithms and may be visible to Clients in aggregate form.

## 5. User Conduct and Acceptable Use

### 5.1 General Conduct

All users (Clients and Experts) agree not to:

* Use the Services for any unlawful, fraudulent, or deceptive purpose.
* Harass, abuse, threaten, or intimidate other users.
* Impersonate any person or entity or misrepresent your affiliation with a person or entity.
* Interfere with, disrupt, or create an undue burden on the Services or the networks or systems connected to the Services.
* Attempt to gain unauthorized access to the Services, other user accounts, or any computer systems or networks connected to the Services.
* Use any automated means (other than authorized API and MCP integrations) to access the Services, including bots, scrapers, or crawlers.
* Reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or otherwise attempt to derive the source code of the Services.
* Circumvent, disable, or otherwise interfere with security-related features of the Services.
* Upload, transmit, or distribute any malicious code, viruses, or other harmful content.
